node.statement: For the entrywise amplification iota_2:B(A)->B(M_2(A)), iota_2(S)([x_ij])=[S(x_ij)], direct entrywise calculation gives iota_2(I_A)=I_{M_2(A)} and iota_2(ST)=iota_2(S)iota_2(T); hence it preserves scalar linear combinations, products, and powers. It is continuous: coordinate compression gives ||x_ij||<=||[x_ij]||, while writing a 2 by 2 matrix as the sum of its four matrix-entry operators gives ||[S(x_ij)]||<=sum_ij ||S(x_ij)||<=4||S|| ||[x_ij]||, so ||iota_2(S)||<=4||S||.
